A '''member''' of the [[Yresilini]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was the second individual trained to be a [[General/Legends|general]] by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] during her [[Time/Legends|time]] at the [[Chiss Academy]]<ref name="CC" /> in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="ETU">''[[Enter the Unknown]]'' places the [[Chiss Academy]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].</ref> Sometime by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">According to [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann's]] databank entry in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'', her training of the [[Yresilini]] took place prior to her involvement in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the young student Tann was tasked by a [[Unidentified professor (Chiss Academy)|professor]] with training the Yresilini into an [[Army/Legends|army]] despite their perceived untrainable nature. Tann selected [[Unidentified first Yresilini general|one]] Yresilini to be her general by teaching him several simple commands, although the Yresilini and his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] laughed in response. Tann had the first general [[Death/Legends|executed]] in view of the other Yresilini and then appointed the second general, who led the Yresilini to follow her orders implicitly. Tann thus received high marks for her work, and the account of the taming of the Yresilini was later repeated by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under her command.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yresilini general was mentioned in Sev'rance Tann's databank entry in the [[2002]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''.<ref name="CC" />
